caption: The drawing depicts a teapot shown in profile, facing to the right. The teapot has a rounded, bulbous body with a smooth surface, rendered in grayscale using pencil shading. The handle on the left side is dark and curved, attached to the main body via a metallic fitting. The spout, on the right, is long and gently curved, extending outward from the upper portion of the teapot's body. The lid is dome-shaped with elongated vertical decorative sections, topped with a finial consisting of a small sphere and pointed tip. In the top left corner of the drawing, there is a rectangular box containing an ornate monogram. The drawing is signed "Amelia Tuccio 1936" in the bottom right corner, and the entire image is framed with a thin rectangular border. The background is plain and unshaded. The overall color scheme is black, white, and shades of gray due to the pencil medium used.
title: Silver Teapot
